body:
## Pull request overview

This PR integrates the ActivityFeed component into the console header and synchronizes the roadmap documentation (Section 11: Success Metrics) with the implementation status across multiple phases (1-3, 15-18). The ActivityFeed replaces a non-functional Bell icon button, providing users with a real notification sidebar, while the documentation updates mark verified L1 features as complete.

**Changes:**
- Integrated ActivityFeed component into AppHeader, replacing dummy Bell icon with functional notification sidebar
- Updated ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md Section 11 to mark L1 items as complete for Phases 1-3, 15, 16, 17, and 18

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/AppHeader.tsx | Replaced non-functional Bell button with ActivityFeed component; added import for ActivityFeed and removed unused Bell icon import |
| ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md | Updated Phase 1-3 success metrics to reflect CRUD dialog migration to ActionDef[]; marked Phase 15, 16, 17, and 18 L1 features as complete with component citations |

The claim "Export button on all view types (Grid, Kanban, Calendar, Gallery) via exportOptions" is inaccurate. While ObjectGrid and ListView have export functionality implemented, Kanban (KanbanImpl.tsx), Calendar (CalendarView.tsx), and Gallery (ObjectGallery.tsx) do not have export functionality. The export feature is only available for Grid and List views, not for all view types as stated.
```suggestion
- [x] Export button for Grid and List views via `exportOptions` (`ObjectGrid`, `ListView`)
- [ ] Export support for Kanban, Calendar, and Gallery views
```
